_help: Roadmap on the home page. 'version' is the release that ships the item (e.g. "0.31"), or null when it has no release yet. build.py moves items to 'Playable now' once that version is the latest release, shows the next version's items under 'Next', and the rest under 'After that'. Add new plans here; items are listed in this order.
